No observed Beast Dojo audience or retention data exists.

metricDefinitions.label: Daily average CCU
metricDefinitions.definition: Daily average CCU is total active player minutes across a complete day divided by 1,440.

caveats: A daily peak or average does not establish a minimum online population.

methods.code:
DAU = average CCU × 1440 ÷ daily minutes per player
1000 × 1440 ÷ 25 = 57600
2000 × 1440 ÷ 25 = 115200

items.title: Why test retention before scaling ads?

queries.summary: Roblox recommends promotion once retention and engagement are healthy. Ads can seed attention but do not buy Recommended for You ranking.

source.label: Roblox discovery and acquisition guidance
caveats: The organic-first sequence is a proposed strategy, not a guarantee of traffic or revenue.

items.title: Does a Mild target establish younger-player access?

queries.summary: The approved design keeps fighting and targets Mild. Final ratings and under-16 access still depend on actual content, current publishing requirements and review.
